stories.canonicalTitle: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 4: the Book of Kiṣkindhā
stories.editorialNote: 依据格里菲斯英译（通行本）第四卷，按卷内情节顺序讲述。罗摩从隐蔽处射杀波林是否合乎正法，在印度传统内部本身就有长久的争论，本站只讲蚁垤本里双方的说法。
stories.summaryEn: In spring by Lake Pampā Rāma is overcome with longing for Sītā. Sugrīva sends Hanumān, disguised as an ascetic, to find out who the brothers are; Rāma and the monkey-king swear friendship before a fire, and Rāma recognises the ornaments Sītā dropped. Sugrīva tells how his brother Vālin took his wife and kingdom; Rāma kicks away the giant Dundubhi's bones and shoots through seven sāl trees to prove his strength. At the second duel Sugrīva wears a garland, and Rāma shoots Vālin from behind a tree; the dying Vālin reproaches him, Rāma answers, and Tārā laments. Crowned, Sugrīva forgets his promise through the rains until Lakṣmaṇa storms into Kiṣkindhā. The armies go out to the four quarters, Rāma gives his ring to Hanumān, and the southern party, lost and despairing, learns from Jaṭāyu's brother Sampāti that Sītā is in Laṅkā across the sea; the old bear Jāmbavān awakens Hanumān's strength.
stories.summaryZh: 春天的般波湖边，罗摩思念悉多，悲伤难抑。须羯哩婆派哈奴曼扮作苦行者来打探，罗摩与猴王在火前结为盟友，认出了悉多扔下的首饰。须羯哩婆讲述了哥哥波林如何夺走他的妻子和王国；罗摩一脚踢飞杜度毗的骸骨、一箭射穿七棵娑罗树，让他相信自己的力量。第二次兄弟决斗时，须羯哩婆戴上花环，罗摩从树后一箭射倒波林，垂死的波林责问罗摩，罗摩作出回答，多罗哀哭不已。须羯哩婆登上王位，雨季过后却沉湎享乐，罗什曼那怒闯猴城。猴军终于分赴四方，罗摩把戒指交给哈奴曼。南路猴军迷失在山洞里，几乎绝望，直到遇见阇吒优私的哥哥商波底，得知悉多在海那边的楞伽；老熊阇婆梵唤醒了哈奴曼身上的力量。
stories.titleZh: 罗摩衍那 · 第四部 猴国篇

claims.statement: In spring at Lake Pampā the beauty of the season deepens Rāma's grief for Sītā until Lakṣmaṇa urges him to take heart.
Sent by Sugrīva and disguised as an ascetic, Hanumān questions Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa with such eloquence that Rāma praises his speech, and carries the brothers to Sugrīva.
Rāma and Sugrīva swear friendship around a sacred fire kindled by Hanumān; Sugrīva shows the ornaments Sītā dropped, which Rāma recognises, and Lakṣmaṇa knows only her anklets.
Sugrīva tells how, after he sealed the cave where Vālin pursued the asura Māyāvī and took the throne believing him dead, Vālin returned, drove him out and took his wife Rumā.
To convince Sugrīva of his strength, Rāma kicks Dundubhi's skeleton ten leagues with his toe and shoots an arrow through seven sāl trees, a mountain and the earth.
At the second duel, with Sugrīva marked by a garland, Rāma shoots Vālin in the chest from behind a tree after Vālin ignores Tārā's warning about Sugrīva's new ally.

The dying Vālin reproaches Rāma for shooting him from hiding; Rāma answers that Vālin deserved death for taking his brother's wife and that he was bound by his promise; Vālin accepts, entrusts Aṅgada to Sugrīva, and Tārā laments.
Crowned king of Kiṣkindhā, Sugrīva spends the rains and the start of autumn in pleasure and forgets his promise, while Rāma waits on Mount Prasravaṇa longing for Sītā.

Sent by Rāma when Sugrīva forgets his promise, Lakṣmaṇa storms into Kiṣkindhā and shakes the palace with his bowstring; calmed by Tārā, he brings the repentant Sugrīva to Rāma as the monkey armies gather.
Sugrīva sends search parties to the four quarters with a month's deadline; Rāma gives Hanumān, who goes south with Aṅgada and Jāmbavān, his ring engraved with his name as a token for Sītā.
The southern search party loses its month in the enchanted cave of the ascetic Svayamprabhā, who sends them to the southern ocean, where Aṅgada and the monkeys resolve to fast to death.

Jaṭāyu's brother Sampāti, whose wings regrow as he speaks, sees Sītā in Laṅkā a hundred leagues across the sea, and the bear-king Jāmbavān recounts Hanumān's birth and powers until he swells to the size of a mountain.

events.summaryEn: They reached Lake Pampā in spring: clear water, lotuses in bloom, bees humming, birds singing in pairs, aśoka and karṇikāra trees aflame with red and yellow flowers.
events.summaryZh: 罗摩和罗什曼那来到般波湖边。

events.summaryEn: On Mount Ṛśyamūka Sugrīva and his four ministers saw two tall armed men coming and leapt up in fear that Vālin had sent them.
events.summaryZh: 哩舍牟迦山上，须羯哩婆和他的四个大臣正坐着，远远看见两个手持弓箭、身材高大的人走来，吓得跳起来，以为是哥哥波林派来杀他的。

events.summaryEn: Hanumān kindled a sacred fire from two sticks, and Rāma and Sugrīva walked around it and swore friendship: one friend's friends and foes would be the other's.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼取来两块木头，钻出火来，点燃了一堆圣火。
events.titleEn: A pact before the fire and Sītā's ornaments
events.titleZh: 火前结盟与悉多的首饰

events.summaryEn: Asked why he was exiled, Sugrīva told his story.
events.summaryZh: 罗摩问起须羯哩婆为什么被哥哥赶出来，须羯哩婆讲了自己的往事。

events.summaryEn: Sugrīva still worried: Vālin leapt every dawn from the western to the eastern sea and the southern to the northern, tossed mountain peaks like balls, and had killed the buffalo-demon Dundubhi with the strength of a thousand elephants, flinging its corpse a league so that its blood spattered a sage's hermitage — hence the curse.
events.summaryZh: 须羯哩婆讲完，又担心地说：罗摩，波林的力量太大了。
events.titleEn: Dundubhi's bones and seven sāl trees
events.titleZh: 杜度毗的骨头与七棵娑罗树

events.summaryEn: Outside Kiṣkindhā Sugrīva roared his challenge and the brothers fought, but from behind his tree Rāma held his arrow: they were identical, and he feared to hit the wrong one.
events.summaryZh: 须羯哩婆来到基什金达城外，大声吼叫，向波林挑战。
events.titleEn: The garland and the death of Vālin

events.summaryEn: Dying, Vālin reproached Rāma: famed for kindness and truth, Rāma had shot him from hiding while he fought another, though Vālin had never wronged him; had Rāma asked, Vālin could have dragged Rāvaṇa to him in a day.
events.summaryZh: 波林倒在地上，看见罗摩和罗什曼那走过来，用尽力气责问罗摩：罗摩，你出身高贵，人人都说你仁慈、守信、正直，我和须羯哩婆打斗，你却从背后暗箭伤人，这算什么正法？
events.titleZh: 波林的责问与多罗的哀哭
events.uncertaintyNote: 罗摩从暗处射杀波林是否合乎正法，在印度传统内部本身就有长久的争论；本站只讲蚁垤本里双方的说法，不作评判。

events.summaryEn: After the funeral Sugrīva was crowned king of Kiṣkindhā with Aṅgada as heir.
events.summaryZh: 波林的葬礼过后，须羯哩婆被拥立为基什金达的国王，安伽陀被立为太子。

events.summaryEn: Seeing autumn come and no sign from Sugrīva, Rāma sent Lakṣmaṇa with a message: the road Vālin took was not yet closed.
events.summaryZh: 罗摩看见秋天已经到了，须羯哩婆却毫无动静，心中焦急又愤怒，对罗什曼那说：秋天到了，正是出兵的时候，须羯哩婆却忘了我们。

events.summaryEn: Sugrīva divided the monkeys into four armies for the four quarters, each under a great captain, and described the mountains, rivers, kingdoms and seas each would pass as if he had seen them — as indeed he had, fleeing Vālin across the whole earth.
events.summaryZh: 须羯哩婆把猴子们分成四路，派往东、南、西、北四个方向，每一路都由一位大将率领。
events.titleEn: Four search parties and a ring

events.summaryEn: The southern army searched every cave and forest of the Vindhyas in vain.
events.summaryZh: 南路的猴军翻山越岭，寻遍了文底耶山的每一个山洞、每一片森林，却连悉多的影子也没找到。

events.summaryEn: A huge wingless old vulture crawled from a cave and rejoiced at so much food.
events.summaryZh: 就在这时，一只巨大的老鹫从山洞里爬了出来，它没有翅膀，看见满海滩的猴子，高兴地说：真是天赐的食物！
events.uncertaintyNote: 后世传统常说哈奴曼因仙人诅咒忘了自己的力量，这个说法出自第七卷（后篇），本节不采用。

versions.labelEn: Griffith translation, Book IV, Kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa (long retelling)
versions.labelZh: 格里菲斯译本第四卷《猴国篇》（长篇讲述）
versions.narrativeScope: 般波湖的春天、哈奴曼来迎、火前结盟、悉多的首饰、须羯哩婆的往事、杜度毗的骨头与七棵娑罗树、花环与波林之死、波林的责问与多罗的哀哭、雨季、罗什曼那之怒、四路寻找与戒指、自生女的山洞、商波底与阇婆梵
versions.rightsNote: 格里菲斯译本属公共领域；本站发布按卷、按情节的独立讲述。《罗摩衍那》是在世的宗教传统的圣典，本站只讲蚁垤本这一个版本。

sections.bodyEn: They reached Lake Pampā in spring: clear water, lotuses in bloom, bees humming, birds singing in pairs, aśoka and karṇikāra trees aflame with red and yellow flowers. The beauty only deepened Rāma's grief: the fragrant breeze and the cuckoo's call seemed to cry for Sītā, who had loved such scenes; did she too think of him in this spring? Its winds and flowers burned his heart like fire, and without her he could not live. Lakṣmaṇa urged him not to give way, for grief saps strength and courage: they would find Sītā even if Rāvaṇa hid underground or in his mother's womb. Rāma dried his tears and walked on with his brother toward Mount Ṛśyamūka.
sections.bodyZh: 罗摩和罗什曼那来到般波湖边。正是春天，湖水清澈，莲花盛开，蜜蜂在花间嗡嗡飞舞，鸟儿成双成对地在枝头歌唱，满山的无忧树、迦尼迦罗树开满红花和黄花，像燃烧的火焰。看着这样美丽的景色，罗摩心中的悲伤反而更深了，对罗什曼那说：弟弟，你看这春天，风带着花香吹来，杜鹃在树上啼叫，就像在呼唤我的悉多。从前在森林里，悉多最喜欢这样的景色。现在春天来了，她却不在我身边。她在哪里？她看见这春天，会不会也在想念我？这春风、这花香、这鸟鸣，都像火一样烧灼着我的心。如果悉多不在了，我也活不下去了。罗什曼那劝他说：哥哥，不要这样悲伤。悲伤会让人失去力量，失去勇气。我们一定能找到悉多，就算罗波那躲到地底下、躲到母亲的肚子里，我们也要把他找出来杀掉。你要振作起来，这才配得上你的身份。罗摩擦干眼泪，和弟弟一起沿着湖边向哩舍牟迦山走去。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·般波湖的春天。

sections.bodyEn: On Mount Ṛśyamūka Sugrīva and his four ministers saw two tall armed men coming and leapt up in fear that Vālin had sent them. Sugrīva sent Hanumān, son of the wind god, to find out. Disguised as a wandering ascetic, Hanumān greeted the brothers with courtesy: why did men radiant as gods, in bark garments yet bearing world-conquering bows, come to this forest? He told of Sugrīva's exile and offered friendship. Rāma marvelled to Lakṣmaṇa: in all those words not one was faulty, his tone and bearing perfect — with such an envoy a king could achieve anything. Lakṣmaṇa told their story and their wish for Sugrīva's help, and Hanumān joyfully resumed his monkey form and carried them both on his back up the mountain.
sections.bodyZh: 哩舍牟迦山上，须羯哩婆和他的四个大臣正坐着，远远看见两个手持弓箭、身材高大的人走来，吓得跳起来，以为是哥哥波林派来杀他的。他对大臣哈奴曼说：你去看看，他们是什么人，到这里来做什么。要是波林派来的，你就做个手势告诉我。哈奴曼是风神的儿子，聪明善辩。他变作一个云游的苦行者，来到罗摩兄弟面前，恭恭敬敬地行礼，说：两位英雄，你们像天神一样光彩照人，穿着苦行者的树皮衣，却带着能征服世界的神弓，为什么到这片森林里来？这里有一位猴王，名叫须羯哩婆，他被哥哥波林赶出了国家，正在这座山上避难。我是他的大臣哈奴曼，风神之子，奉他的命令来向你们致意。他想和你们结为朋友。罗摩听了，对罗什曼那说：你听，他说话多么得体！他精通吠陀，说了这么多话，没有一个字是错的，语调和表情都恰到好处。一个国王要是有这样的使者，什么事都能办成。罗什曼那就把他们的身世和悉多被劫的事告诉了哈奴曼，说：我们正是来找须羯哩婆的，希望得到他的帮助。哈奴曼欢喜地恢复了猴子的原形，把罗摩和罗什曼那背在背上，带他们上了哩舍牟迦山。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·哈奴曼来迎。

sections.bodyEn: Hanumān kindled a sacred fire from two sticks, and Rāma and Sugrīva walked around it and swore friendship: one friend's friends and foes would be the other's. Rāma would kill Vālin and restore Sugrīva's wife and kingdom; Sugrīva would find Sītā. He had seen a rākṣasa carrying a woman through the sky crying 'Rāma! Lakṣmaṇa!', and she had dropped a bundle of ornaments. When it was brought, Rāma clutched the golden scarf and jewels to his breast and wept. Lakṣmaṇa said he did not know the earrings or bracelets, only the anklets, for each day when he bowed to his sister-in-law he had looked only at her feet. Sugrīva did not know where the rākṣasa lived, but vowed to find Sītā in heaven or below the earth.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼取来两块木头，钻出火来，点燃了一堆圣火。罗摩和须羯哩婆围着火绕行，结为盟友，发誓同甘共苦。须羯哩婆说：从今天起，你的朋友就是我的朋友，你的敌人就是我的敌人。罗摩说：我会帮你杀死波林，夺回你的妻子和王国。须羯哩婆说：我也会帮你找回悉多。我知道她被劫走了，那天我和四个大臣坐在这山上，看见罗波那抱着一个女人从空中飞过，她哭喊着“罗摩！罗什曼那！”还扔下了一包首饰。说着，他叫人把那包首饰拿来。罗摩一看见那条金色的披巾和那些首饰，就认出是悉多的，紧紧抱在胸前，放声痛哭，泪如雨下。他叫罗什曼那：弟弟，你看，这是悉多的首饰！罗什曼那说：哥哥，耳环我不认得，手镯我也不认得，只有这对脚镯我认得，因为我每天向嫂嫂行礼时，只看她的双脚。罗摩问须羯哩婆：那个罗刹往哪里去了？他住在哪里？须羯哩婆说：我不知道他住在哪里，可是我向你保证，我一定会找到悉多，不论她在天上还是在地下。你不要悲伤，像你这样的人不应该被悲伤压倒。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·结盟与悉多的首饰。
sections.headingEn: A pact before the fire and Sītā's ornaments
sections.headingZh: 火前结盟与悉多的首饰

sections.bodyEn: Asked why he was exiled, Sugrīva told his story. Vālin, son of Indra and king of Kiṣkindhā, was mightily strong, and Sugrīva, son of the sun, served him like a father. One night the asura Māyāvī challenged Vālin at the gate; chased by both brothers, the demon fled into a deep cave, and Vālin went in, telling Sugrīva to guard the mouth. A whole year passed; then foaming blood flowed out with the roars of asuras and no sound of Vālin. Believing his brother dead, Sugrīva blocked the cave with a boulder and returned, and the ministers made him king. But Vālin had killed Māyāvī; pushing the stone aside, he found his brother on the throne and, believing he had been walled in on purpose, would not forgive him despite every apology, drove him out and took his wife Rumā. Sugrīva had found refuge only on Ṛśyamūka, where a sage's curse forbade Vālin to set foot.
sections.bodyZh: 罗摩问起须羯哩婆为什么被哥哥赶出来，须羯哩婆讲了自己的往事。波林是因陀罗的儿子，力大无比，是猴国基什金达的国王；须羯哩婆是太阳神的儿子，一向敬重哥哥，像侍奉父亲一样侍奉他。有一天夜里，一个名叫摩耶毗的阿修罗来到城门前，向波林挑战。波林冲出城去，须羯哩婆也跟着出去。摩耶毗见了兄弟二人，害怕起来，逃进了一个深深的山洞。波林对须羯哩婆说：你在洞口守着，我进去杀了他。我不出来，你不要离开。波林进了山洞，过了整整一年也没有出来。一天，洞里流出了带着泡沫的鲜血，还传来阿修罗们的吼叫声，却听不见波林的声音。须羯哩婆以为哥哥被杀死了，怕阿修罗冲出来，就搬来一块大石头堵住洞口，回到城里。大臣们以为波林已死，拥立须羯哩婆为王。可是不久，波林杀死了摩耶毗，推开石头回来了，看见须羯哩婆坐在王位上，以为弟弟故意把他关在洞里篡夺王位，勃然大怒。须羯哩婆再三解释、低头认罪，把王位还给他，波林都不肯原谅，把他赶出了国家，还夺走了他的妻子卢摩。须羯哩婆逃遍天下，最后躲到这座哩舍牟迦山上，因为一位仙人诅咒过波林，他踏上这座山就会死，所以只有这里是安全的。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·须羯哩婆的往事。

sections.bodyEn: Sugrīva still worried: Vālin leapt every dawn from the western to the eastern sea and the southern to the northern, tossed mountain peaks like balls, and had killed the buffalo-demon Dundubhi with the strength of a thousand elephants, flinging its corpse a league so that its blood spattered a sage's hermitage — hence the curse. There lay the skeleton like a hill, and there stood seven sāl trees Vālin could shake bare. With his big toe Rāma flicked the skeleton ten leagues; but the bones were dry and light now, Sugrīva objected. Then Rāma loosed an arrow that pierced all seven sāl trees, the mountain behind them and the earth below, and returned to his quiver. Sugrīva knelt: like Indra, Rāma could beat Vālin even with the gods on his side. He would challenge Vālin that day.
sections.bodyZh: 须羯哩婆讲完，又担心地说：罗摩，波林的力量太大了。他每天清晨从西海跳到东海，再跳到南海和北海，一点也不累；他能把山峰抛到空中，再像玩球一样接住。从前有一个像水牛一样的阿修罗，名叫杜度毗，力气有一千头大象那么大，波林抓住它的角，把它摔死，又把它的尸体扔出一由旬远，鲜血溅到了一位仙人的净修林，所以那位仙人诅咒了波林。你看，那就是杜度毗的骸骨，像一座小山。那边的七棵娑罗树，波林能一棵一棵地把它们摇得叶子落光。我不知道你能不能打败他。罗什曼那笑着问：要怎样你才相信？罗摩走上前去，用一只脚的大脚趾轻轻一挑，就把那堆巨大的骸骨踢飞了十由旬远。须羯哩婆说：杜度毗的骨头现在是干的，很轻，波林当年扔的时候，它还是新鲜的，又重又湿。罗摩又拿起弓，搭上一支箭，用力射出，那支箭射穿了七棵娑罗树，又射穿了山，钻进地底，再飞回到罗摩的箭囊里。须羯哩婆看得目瞪口呆，跪在罗摩面前说：你就像天帝因陀罗一样，就算众神来帮波林，你也能打败他！今天我就去向波林挑战。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·杜度毗的骸骨与七棵娑罗树。
sections.headingEn: Dundubhi's bones and seven sāl trees
sections.headingZh: 杜度毗的骨头与七棵娑罗树

sections.bodyEn: Outside Kiṣkindhā Sugrīva roared his challenge and the brothers fought, but from behind his tree Rāma held his arrow: they were identical, and he feared to hit the wrong one. Bruised and bloody, Sugrīva fled and reproached him; Rāma explained, and Lakṣmaṇa hung a flowering creeper round Sugrīva's neck as a sign. When Sugrīva challenged again, Vālin's wife Tārā held him back: so quick a return meant a powerful ally — Prince Aṅgada had heard of Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa's pact with Sugrīva; better to make peace and name Sugrīva heir. Vālin would not retreat from a challenge; he would only teach his brother a lesson. This time Rāma knew Sugrīva by the garland, and as Sugrīva weakened he loosed a serpent-like arrow from behind the tree into Vālin's chest, and Vālin fell like a felled tree.
sections.bodyZh: 须羯哩婆来到基什金达城外，大声吼叫，向波林挑战。波林怒冲冲地冲出城来，兄弟二人扭打在一起，你一拳我一脚，打得天昏地暗。罗摩藏在树后，拉开弓，却迟迟没有射出——兄弟两个长得一模一样，身材、相貌、动作都分不出来，他怕射错了人。须羯哩婆被打得鼻青脸肿，满身是血，逃回哩舍牟迦山，埋怨罗摩：你说要帮我，为什么不射？要是你不想杀他，早说就是了！罗摩说：须羯哩婆，你们兄弟俩一模一样，我分不出哪个是你，要是我射错了，就会毁掉我们的盟约。罗什曼那摘来一串开着花的蔓藤，挂在须羯哩婆的脖子上，作为记号。须羯哩婆又来到城外挑战。波林正要出城，他的妻子多罗拦住他说：大王，今天不要出去！须羯哩婆刚被打败，又这么快回来挑战，一定是有了强大的帮手。我听王子安伽陀说，十车王的两个儿子罗摩和罗什曼那来到了森林，和须羯哩婆结了盟。罗摩是正法的化身，你不如把须羯哩婆请回来，立他为太子，与他和好吧。波林不听，说：我不能在挑战面前退缩。我不会杀死他，只是要教训他。他冲出城去，和须羯哩婆打了起来。这一次，须羯哩婆脖子上挂着花环，罗摩一眼就认出了他。当须羯哩婆渐渐不支时，罗摩搭上一支像蛇一样的箭，从树后射出，正中波林的胸膛，波林像一棵被砍倒的大树，轰然倒在地上。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·波林之死。
sections.headingEn: The garland and the death of Vālin

sections.bodyEn: Dying, Vālin reproached Rāma: famed for kindness and truth, Rāma had shot him from hiding while he fought another, though Vālin had never wronged him; had Rāma asked, Vālin could have dragged Rāvaṇa to him in a day. Rāma answered that the earth belonged to the Ikṣvākus, now ruled by Bharata, at whose command the brothers upheld dharma and punished wrong; Vālin had taken his living brother's wife, who should be like a daughter to him, a crime deserving death; a king may shoot a beast openly or from hiding; and Rāma had given his word to Sugrīva. After a silence Vālin acknowledged his fault and asked only that Rāma care for his son Aṅgada and that Tārā not suffer. Tārā threw herself on him, wailing that he who slept on soft beds now lay in the dust, and begged Rāma to shoot her too; Sugrīva wept in remorse. Vālin gave Sugrīva his golden necklace, entrusted Aṅgada to him and closed his eyes.
sections.bodyZh: 波林倒在地上，看见罗摩和罗什曼那走过来，用尽力气责问罗摩：罗摩，你出身高贵，人人都说你仁慈、守信、正直，我和须羯哩婆打斗，你却从背后暗箭伤人，这算什么正法？我从来没有冒犯过你，也没有侵犯过你的国土。你若是光明正大地和我交战，今天倒在地上的就是你了。你如果要找悉多，只要对我说一声，我一天之内就能把罗波那绑来交给你。你杀了我，不过是为了一个篡位的弟弟，这是不正义的！罗摩回答说：波林，你不懂正法，却来指责我。这片大地，连同山林和百姓，都属于甘蔗王族，现在由婆罗多统治，我们兄弟奉他的命令执行正法、惩罚罪恶。你在弟弟还活着的时候，夺走了他的妻子卢摩，弟媳就像女儿一样，你这是犯了大罪，按照律法应当处死。至于我从隐蔽处射你，你是猴子，国王打猎时，不论是公开还是隐蔽，都可以射杀野兽。何况我已经答应了须羯哩婆，我不能违背诺言。波林听了，沉默了一会儿，说：罗摩，你说得对，我错了，请你原谅我。我只求你，像对待须羯哩婆一样照顾我的儿子安伽陀，不要让须羯哩婆为难多罗。波林的妻子多罗听说丈夫中箭，带着儿子安伽陀跑出城来，扑在波林身上放声痛哭：你曾经睡在柔软的床上，现在却躺在泥土里！我劝过你，你却不听。罗摩，请你用射死他的那支箭也射死我吧，让我到天上去陪伴他。须羯哩婆看见哥哥临死的模样，也后悔地哭了起来。波林把脖子上的金项链交给须羯哩婆，嘱咐他照顾安伽陀，然后闭上了眼睛。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·波林的责问与多罗的哀哭。
sections.headingZh: 波林的责问与多罗的哀哭
sections.uncertaintyNote: 罗摩从暗处射杀波林是否合乎正法，在印度传统内部本身就有长久的争论；本站只讲蚁垤本里双方的说法，不作评判。

sections.bodyEn: After the funeral Sugrīva was crowned king of Kiṣkindhā with Aṅgada as heir. Rāma, who as an exile could not enter a city, told him to rest through the coming rains and begin the search when the month of Kārttika came. The brothers lived in a cave on Mount Prasravaṇa as the monsoon gathered like elephants, thunder rolled, lightning lashed the clouds, rivers flooded, peacocks danced and frogs sang; Rāma wondered whether Sītā too watched these clouds and thought of him. At last autumn came — clear skies, bright moon, swans on the lakes — but Sugrīva, drinking and pleasuring day and night with Rumā and Vālin's widow Tārā, had forgotten his promise. Hanumān warned him it was time to repay his friend; Sugrīva ordered the monkeys summoned, then went back to his wine.
sections.bodyZh: 波林的葬礼过后，须羯哩婆被拥立为基什金达的国王，安伽陀被立为太子。须羯哩婆请罗摩进城住进王宫，罗摩说：我在流放期间不能进入城市和村庄。现在雨季就要到了，雨季里不能出兵寻找，你先在城里安顿下来，等雨季过后，迦尔底迦月一到，就开始寻找悉多。罗摩和罗什曼那住在钵罗斯拉婆那山的一个山洞里。雨季来了，乌云像大象一样聚集在天空，雷声隆隆，闪电像金鞭一样抽打着云层，大雨倾盆而下，河水暴涨，孔雀在山间跳舞，青蛙在水塘里鸣叫。罗摩看着这雨季的景色，又想起了悉多：她在楞伽城里，是不是也在看着这些乌云，想着我？罗什曼那陪着他，不断安慰他。漫长的雨季终于过去了，秋天来了，天空清澈，月光明亮，河水退去，露出了沙滩，天鹅在湖上游弋。可是须羯哩婆在城里沉湎于酒色，和妻子卢摩、还有波林的遗孀多罗日夜饮酒作乐，早把寻找悉多的诺言忘得一干二净。哈奴曼看出了事情不妙，劝他说：大王，你已经得到了王国和荣耀，现在该是报答朋友的时候了。罗摩虽然没有催你，可是寻找悉多的时候已经到了。须羯哩婆这才下令召集各地的猴兵，可是转身又回去饮酒了。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·雨季。

sections.bodyEn: Seeing autumn come and no sign from Sugrīva, Rāma sent Lakṣmaṇa with a message: the road Vālin took was not yet closed. Lakṣmaṇa strode to Kiṣkindhā with his bow, and the monkeys at the gate fled. Sugrīva was too drunk to listen to Aṅgada, until Lakṣmaṇa's twang of his bowstring shook the palace. Afraid to face him, Sugrīva sent Tārā, flushed with wine and loosely dressed: Sugrīva had not forgotten; after years of suffering he had yielded to pleasure, as even the great Viśvāmitra had been held ten years by a nymph; the summons had already gone out and millions of monkeys were on their way. Lakṣmaṇa's anger cooled; Sugrīva apologised, Lakṣmaṇa regretted his harsh words, and Sugrīva went in a litter to kneel before Rāma. Soon monkeys and bears poured in like a tide, darkening the sky.
sections.bodyZh: 罗摩看见秋天已经到了，须羯哩婆却毫无动静，心中焦急又愤怒，对罗什曼那说：秋天到了，正是出兵的时候，须羯哩婆却忘了我们。他得到了想要的东西，就不再理会朋友了。你去基什金达告诉他：波林走过的那条路还没有关闭，让他守住约定，不要跟着波林走上那条路！罗什曼那怒气冲冲，拿着弓直奔基什金达。守城的猴子们看见他满脸怒容，吓得四散奔逃。王子安伽陀急忙进宫去报告，须羯哩婆却喝得醉醺醺的，听不进去。罗什曼那走进王宫，用力拉了一下弓弦，弓弦声震得整座宫殿都在发抖。须羯哩婆这才清醒过来，吓得不敢出去，就叫多罗去见罗什曼那。多罗醉眼朦胧，衣衫不整，走到罗什曼那面前，说：王子，请不要发怒。须羯哩婆没有忘记罗摩的恩情，他受了多年的苦，刚刚得到享受，一时贪恋，这也是人之常情，连伟大的仙人众友也曾被天女迷住了十年。他早已下令召集各地的猴兵，千千万万的猴子正在赶来。罗什曼那听了，怒气渐渐平息。须羯哩婆出来向他赔罪，罗什曼那也说了几句过重的话，向他道歉。须羯哩婆坐上轿子，跟着罗什曼那去见罗摩，跪在罗摩脚下。不久，各地的猴子和熊像潮水一样涌来，遮天蔽日，数也数不清。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·罗什曼那之怒与多罗。

sections.bodyEn: Sugrīva divided the monkeys into four armies for the four quarters, each under a great captain, and described the mountains, rivers, kingdoms and seas each would pass as if he had seen them — as indeed he had, fleeing Vālin across the whole earth. All must report within a month on pain of death. The southern army, under Prince Aṅgada with Hanumān, the old bear-king Jāmbavān and Nīla, mattered most. To Hanumān Sugrīva said that like his father the wind he could cross sky and sea and the worlds of the gods, unmatched in strength, wisdom and courage: the task fell to him. Rāma too thought Hanumān most likely to succeed and gave him his ring engraved with his name, so that Sītā would trust him. Hanumān raised it to his head, bowed and set out south.
sections.bodyZh: 须羯哩婆把猴子们分成四路，派往东、南、西、北四个方向，每一路都由一位大将率领。他对每一路都详细描述了要经过的山川、河流、国家和海洋，就像亲眼见过一样——原来他当年被波林追赶时，曾经逃遍了整个大地。他吩咐他们：一个月之内，必须回来报告，谁要是超过了期限，我就处死谁。往南方去的一路最重要，由王子安伽陀率领，跟着的有哈奴曼、老熊王阇婆梵、尼罗等勇士。须羯哩婆特别对哈奴曼说：哈奴曼，你像你的父亲风神一样，能飞越天空和海洋，在大地、天空、众神的世界里来去自如，你的力量、智慧和勇气，世上无人能比。找到悉多的重任，就落在你身上了。罗摩也觉得哈奴曼最有可能找到悉多，就从手指上取下一枚刻着自己名字的戒指，交给哈奴曼，说：悉多看见这枚戒指，就会相信你是我派去的，不会害怕你。哈奴曼双手合十，接过戒指，把它举到头上，向罗摩行礼，然后带着南路的猴军出发了。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·四路寻找与戒指。
sections.headingEn: Four search parties and a ring

sections.bodyEn: The southern army searched every cave and forest of the Vindhyas in vain. Hungry and thirsty, they saw wet birds flying from a dark cave and groped inside hand in hand, until light broke on a golden land of jewelled pools, silver palaces, fruit trees and sweet springs built by the asura architect Maya, where a radiant ascetic named Svayamprabhā lived. She fed them and, since no one who entered could leave, told them to close their eyes — and they stood on the shore of the southern ocean. Only then did they realise their month had long passed. Aṅgada despaired: Sugrīva disliked him and would kill him; better to fast to death here. The monkeys spread grass on the shore and sat facing east to die, and even Hanumān could not lift their hope.
sections.bodyZh: 南路的猴军翻山越岭，寻遍了文底耶山的每一个山洞、每一片森林，却连悉多的影子也没找到。他们又饿又渴，来到一座山前，看见一个黑漆漆的大山洞，洞口飞出许多湿淋淋的鸟儿，猜想里面一定有水。他们手拉着手，在黑暗中摸索前进，走了很久，眼前忽然一亮，出现了一片金光灿灿的地方：金色的树木、宝石的池塘、银子的宫殿，还有满树的果子和清甜的泉水。一位穿着树皮衣、光彩照人的女苦行者坐在那里，她名叫自生女，这座宫殿是阿修罗的工匠摩耶建造的。她让猴子们吃饱喝足，听了他们的来意，说：进了这个山洞的人，是出不去的。不过我会用苦行的力量帮你们。你们闭上眼睛。猴子们闭上眼睛，一转眼，已经站在了南方的大海边。他们这才发现，在山洞里迷失的时候，一个月的期限早已过去了。安伽陀绝望地说：我们没有找到悉多，超过了期限，回去也是死。须羯哩婆本来就不喜欢我，他一定会借机杀了我。我宁愿在这海边绝食而死。猴子们都跟着他，在海边铺上草，面朝东方坐下，准备绝食而死。哈奴曼劝他们不要灰心，可是大家都已经没有了希望。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·自生女的山洞与绝望。

sections.bodyEn: A huge wingless old vulture crawled from a cave and rejoiced at so much food. Aṅgada sighed that they would die for Rāma like Jaṭāyu — and at that name the bird cried out: Jaṭāyu was his brother! He was Sampāti; racing his brother toward the sun, he had spread his wings to shield Jaṭāyu and they had burned, so he fell here. But his eyes still saw far: Laṅkā lay a hundred leagues across the sea, and there in the aśoka grove sat Sītā in yellow, guarded by rākṣasīs. As he spoke, new wings grew and he flew away. Who could leap a hundred leagues? Each monkey named his distance. Then Jāmbavān turned to the silent Hanumān: as a child, son of the wind, he had leapt three hundred leagues at the rising sun thinking it a ripe fruit, and Indra's thunderbolt had struck his jaw, hence his name; the gods had blessed him with his father's strength and speed, which he had never yet put forth in full. Hanumān began to swell, tall as a mountain, and roared like a lion that he would leap the sea.
sections.bodyZh: 就在这时，一只巨大的老鹫从山洞里爬了出来，它没有翅膀，看见满海滩的猴子，高兴地说：真是天赐的食物！我可以一个一个慢慢吃了。猴子们吓坏了，安伽陀叹气说：我们就像阇吒优私一样，为了罗摩死在这里。那老鹫听见“阇吒优私”这个名字，大声问：你们说的阇吒优私是我的弟弟！他怎么了？安伽陀把阇吒优私为了救悉多被罗波那杀死的事说了。老鹫痛哭起来，说：我叫商波底，从前我们兄弟俩比赛谁飞得高，一直飞向太阳，阇吒优私快要被烧着了，我张开翅膀护住他，我的翅膀被太阳烧焦了，就掉在了这里，再也飞不起来。我的眼睛还能看很远。我看见了！罗波那的楞伽城就在这大海对面一百由旬远的岛上，悉多被关在那里的无忧树林中，穿着黄色的衣服，被女罗刹们看守着。话音刚落，商波底身上竟然长出了新的翅膀，他欢喜地飞上天空走了。可是一百由旬的大海，谁能跳过去？猴子们一个个说出自己能跳多远：有的说十由旬，有的说五十由旬，安伽陀说他能跳过去，却不一定能跳回来。老熊王阇婆梵走到一直沉默的哈奴曼身边，说：哈奴曼，你为什么一言不发？你是风神的儿子，你小时候看见初升的太阳，以为是一个熟透的果子，一跃三百由旬扑向太阳，因陀罗用雷杵打中了你的下巴，所以你叫哈奴曼。众神赐给你恩典，你的力量和速度和你的父亲一样，可你从来没有把它全部拿出来过。现在，正是用它的时候了！哈奴曼听了，身体开始膨胀，越来越大，像一座山一样高，发出狮子一样的吼声，说：我要跳过大海，找到悉多！
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第四卷·商波底与阇婆梵。
sections.uncertaintyNote: 后世传统常说哈奴曼因仙人诅咒忘了自己的力量，这个说法出自第七卷（后篇），本节不采用。

stories.canonicalTitle: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 5: the Beautiful Book
stories.editorialNote: 依据格里菲斯英译（通行本）第五卷，按卷内情节顺序讲述。
stories.summaryEn: Hanumān leaps from Mount Mahendra, rests on no mountain, passes Surasā's test, tears Siṃhikā apart and lands on Mount Trikūṭa. Shrunk to a cat's size, he overcomes Laṅkā's guardian goddess, searches Rāvaṇa's palaces by moonlight and at last finds Sītā in the aśoka grove among rākṣasīs. He watches Rāvaṇa threaten her and Sītā answer across a blade of grass, hears the old rākṣasī Trijaṭā's dream of Rāma's victory, sings Rāma's story softly from the tree, gives the ring and receives her crest-jewel and the secret tale of the crow. He wrecks the grove, kills Prince Akṣa, is bound by Indrajit's weapon of Brahmā, counsels Rāvaṇa to his face, and when his tail is set alight burns Laṅkā, then leaps home to tell Rāma: 'I have seen Sītā.'
stories.summaryZh: 哈奴曼从摩亨陀罗山一跃而起，越过弥那迦山、通过蛇母须罗娑的考验、撕开女妖辛悉迦，落在楞伽的三峰山上。他缩小身体潜入城中，打倒楞伽城的守护女神，在月光下搜遍罗波那的宫殿，最后在无忧树林里找到了被女罗刹围着的悉多。他亲眼看见罗波那威胁悉多、悉多隔着一根草斥责他，又听见老女罗刹特哩阇吒讲述预示罗摩胜利的梦。他在树上轻轻唱起罗摩的故事，递上戒指，悉多把髻珠交给他，又讲了只有她和罗摩知道的乌鸦的故事。哈奴曼毁掉树林、杀死王子阿刹，被因陀罗耆用梵天神兵擒住，在罗波那殿前直言相劝，尾巴被点燃后反而火烧楞伽，最后跃回大海对岸，在蜜林里和猴子们欢庆，向罗摩报告：我见到悉多了！
stories.titleZh: 罗摩衍那 · 第五部 美妙篇

claims.statement: Hanumān leaps from Mount Mahendra, shaking the mountain, and declines to rest on the golden mountain Maināka, which the Ocean raises for him in gratitude to the Ikṣvākus.
Hanumān passes the test of Surasā by shrinking to a thumb's size and darting in and out of her widening mouth, and kills the shadow-seizing demoness Siṃhikā from within.
Shrunk to a cat's size, Hanumān enters Laṅkā by night and knocks down the city's guardian goddess, who recognises the sign Brahmā foretold of the rākṣasas' doom.
Searching Rāvaṇa's palace by night, Hanumān mistakes the sleeping queen Mandodarī for Sītā, then reasons that Sītā would never sleep adorned and at ease beside another man.
From a śiṃśapā tree in the aśoka grove Hanumān recognises Sītā, thin and unadorned among hideous rākṣasī guards, by Rāma's description and by ornaments matching those she had dropped.

When Rāvaṇa woos and threatens her in the aśoka grove, Sītā answers him across a blade of grass that she belongs to Rāma as light to the sun, and he leaves her two months before he will have her killed.
When the rākṣasīs threaten to devour Sītā, the old rākṣasī Trijaṭā tells them of her dream of Rāma's triumph and Rāvaṇa's ruin, and they stop threatening her.
Seeing Sītā about to hang herself with her braid, Hanumān softly sings Rāma's story from the tree in ordinary speech so as not to frighten her.
Hanumān gives Sītā Rāma's ring; she refuses to be carried away on his back because she will not willingly touch another man and Rāma himself must rescue her, and gives him her crest-jewel as a token.
As a token known only to her and Rāma, Sītā tells Hanumān how Rāma once loosed Brahmā's weapon in a blade of grass against a crow, a son of Indra, that pecked her breast on Citrakūṭa.
Hanumān wrecks the aśoka grove, kills Rāvaṇa's guards, generals and son Akṣa, and lets himself be taken before Rāvaṇa after Indrajit binds him with the weapon of Brahmā.

Before Rāvaṇa, Hanumān declares himself Sugrīva's envoy and urges him to return Sītā since his boon does not protect him from men and monkeys; Vibhīṣaṇa saves him from execution because envoys may not be killed.
With his tail set alight by Rāvaṇa's order but made cool by Sītā's prayer to the fire god, Hanumān breaks free and burns Laṅkā, sparing Vibhīṣaṇa's house, and returns to find Sītā unharmed.
Hanumān leaps back across the sea, the monkeys celebrate in Sugrīva's honey grove, and he gives Rāma Sītā's crest-jewel, whereupon Rāma embraces him as the only reward equal to his deed.

events.summaryEn: On Mount Mahendra Hanumān grew huge, bowed to the sun, Indra, Brahmā and the wind, and pressed down on the summit: rocks split, springs burst out, flowers rained down, beasts roared in their caves and vidyādharas flew up with their wives to watch.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼登上摩亨陀罗山，身体越变越大，他向太阳、因陀罗、梵天、风神行礼，然后用双脚踩住山顶。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: To test him the gods sent Surasā, mother of serpents, in a rākṣasī's form to block his path: the gods had given him to her as food.
events.summaryZh: 众神想考验一下哈奴曼的力量和智慧，就请蛇母须罗娑变成一个可怕的罗刹女，从海中升起，拦住他的去路，说：众神把你赐给我做食物，进我嘴里来吧！
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Hanumān landed fresh on three-peaked Trikūṭa and looked at Laṅkā: golden walls, jewelled gates, palaces touching the clouds, lotus-filled moats and armed rākṣasas on every wall, like a city of the gods.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼终于看见了海那边的岛屿：岛上有一座三峰山，山顶上就是楞伽城。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Moonlight lit the streets as Hanumān searched: houses ringing with song, Vedic recitation, drinking and quarrels; guards with one eye or one ear, pot-bellies or humps.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼在楞伽城中穿行，月光照亮了街道。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Hanumān leapt the wall into the flowering aśoka grove and climbed a leafy śiṃśapā tree.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼跳过围墙，进入无忧树林。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Near dawn Rāvaṇa came with a hundred wives bearing golden lamps, half drunk and burning with desire.
events.summaryZh: 天快亮的时候，罗波那带着上百个妻子来到无忧树林，宫女们举着金灯，簇拥着他，他喝得半醉，欲火中烧，径直走到悉多面前。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: The rākṣasīs crowded round Sītā, some coaxing her toward the riches of Rāvaṇa's queen, others brandishing spears and axes and lolling their tongues, one wanting her heart, one her liver, one her blood.
events.summaryZh: 罗波那走后，女罗刹们围住悉多，有的劝她：罗波那是天下最强大的国王，你做他的王后，有享不尽的荣华富贵，何必为了一个穷苦行者受苦？
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Alone and despairing, Sītā loosened her long braid to hang herself from a branch — and then her left eye, arm and thigh began to throb, an auspicious sign for a woman, and her heart steadied.
events.summaryZh: 悉多孤零零地坐在树下，绝望之中，她解下自己的长发辫，想用它吊死在树枝上。
events.titleEn: Rāma's story sung from the tree
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Hanumān climbed down and bowed: was she Sītā?
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼从树上下来，恭恭敬敬地向悉多行礼，说：您是谁？
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: So that Rāma would be sure, Sītā told a story only the two of them knew.
events.summaryZh: 为了让罗摩确信哈奴曼真的见到了她，悉多又讲了一件只有她和罗摩两个人知道的往事：那时我们住在质多罗俱吒山上，有一天，罗摩累了，枕在我的腿上睡着了。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Having found Sītā, Hanumān resolved to test the rākṣasas' strength for Rāma.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼告别了悉多，心想：我已经找到了悉多，可是还应该看看罗刹们的力量，好回去告诉罗摩。
events.titleEn: The grove destroyed and Hanumān bound

events.summaryEn: On his crystal throne under a pearl-studded crown, his eyes blazing in ten heads, Rāvaṇa was so splendid that Hanumān thought that, but for his evil, he might have been a protector of the gods.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼被押到罗波那的大殿上。

events.summaryEn: The rākṣasas wrapped his tail in old cotton and rags, soaked it in oil, set it alight and paraded him through the streets with drums — which suited Hanumān, who studied the city's defences by day.
events.summaryZh: 罗刹们用旧棉布和破布把哈奴曼的尾巴一圈一圈地缠起来，浇上油，点着了火。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Hanumān pressed Mount Ariṣṭa into the earth as he leapt and flew back like a cloud.
events.summaryZh: 哈奴曼向悉多告别，登上楞伽城外的阿利湿多山，用力一蹬，大山都陷进了地里，他像一片乌云一样飞越大海。

versions.labelEn: Griffith translation, Book V, Sundara Kāṇḍa (long retelling)
versions.labelZh: 格里菲斯译本第五卷《美妙篇》（长篇讲述）
versions.narrativeScope: 跨海一跃、弥那迦山、须罗娑与辛悉迦、楞伽城的守护女神、夜探宫殿、无忧树林中的悉多、罗波那的威胁与一根草、特哩阇吒的梦、哈奴曼唱罗摩的故事、戒指与髻珠、乌鸦的故事、毁林与被擒、罗波那殿前、火烧楞伽、蜜林与回报
versions.rightsNote: 格里菲斯译本属公共领域；本站发布按卷、按情节的独立讲述。《罗摩衍那》是在世的宗教传统的圣典，本站只讲蚁垤本这一个版本。

sections.bodyEn: On Mount Mahendra Hanumān grew huge, bowed to the sun, Indra, Brahmā and the wind, and pressed down on the summit: rocks split, springs burst out, flowers rained down, beasts roared in their caves and vidyādharas flew up with their wives to watch. He would fly like Rāma's arrow, he said; if Sītā was not in Laṅkā he would search heaven, and if not there he would bring Rāvaṇa bound. With one thrust he shot into the sky; trees torn up by his passage flew after him and fell into the sea, strewing it with flowers. His shadow on the water was like a great ship. The Ocean, remembering what it owed Sagara of the Ikṣvāku line, raised the golden mountain Maināka from the depths to give him rest; Hanumān touched its peak with his chest in thanks but would not stop until his task was done.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼登上摩亨陀罗山，身体越变越大，他向太阳、因陀罗、梵天、风神行礼，然后用双脚踩住山顶。大山承受不住他的重量，山上的岩石崩裂，泉水喷涌，树木摇晃，花朵纷纷落下，山洞里的野兽惊慌地吼叫，修行的持明仙人们带着妻子飞到空中观看。哈奴曼对猴子们说：我要像罗摩的箭一样，以风的速度飞向楞伽。如果在楞伽找不到悉多，我就飞到天上去找；如果天上也找不到，我就把罗波那绑来！说完，他用尽全身力气一蹬，像一支离弦的箭冲上天空，他飞过的地方，树木被连根拔起，跟在他身后飞了一段才落进海里，海面上漂满了五颜六色的花朵。他的影子落在海面上，像一艘大船；他两臂伸展，像两条飞翔的巨蛇；他的眼睛像山上燃烧的火。大海想：哈奴曼是为了甘蔗王族的罗摩去办事的，而大海曾经得到甘蔗王族的祖先娑竭罗的恩惠，我应该帮助他。于是大海叫海底的弥那迦山升出水面，说：你让哈奴曼在你的山顶上歇一歇吧。弥那迦山升出海面，金光闪闪的山峰上长满了树木，山神变作人形，请哈奴曼休息。哈奴曼用胸口轻轻碰了一下山顶，表示感谢，说：我有使命在身，不能停留，我发过誓，在完成任务之前不停下来。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·跨海与弥那迦山。

sections.bodyEn: To test him the gods sent Surasā, mother of serpents, in a rākṣasī's form to block his path: the gods had given him to her as food. He promised to enter her mouth once he had found Sītā; but no one could pass her, by Brahmā's boon. As he grew to ten leagues, she opened her mouth to twenty; he to thirty, she to forty — until her jaws gaped a hundred leagues. Then he shrank to the size of a thumb, darted in and out, and said her boon was fulfilled; resuming her form, she blessed him. Further on he felt himself dragged back like a ship against the wind: the demoness Siṃhikā, who seized flying creatures by their shadows on the water, rose with gaping jaws. He grew, she widened her mouth; he shrank, darted in, tore her heart with his claws and burst out, and she sank dead while the gods cheered.
sections.bodyZh: 众神想考验一下哈奴曼的力量和智慧，就请蛇母须罗娑变成一个可怕的罗刹女，从海中升起，拦住他的去路，说：众神把你赐给我做食物，进我嘴里来吧！哈奴曼双手合十说：我是罗摩的使者，正要去寻找他被劫走的妻子悉多。等我找到了悉多，告诉了罗摩，我就回来进你的嘴。须罗娑说：谁也不能从我面前过去，这是梵天赐给我的恩典。她张开大嘴。哈奴曼就把身体变大到十由旬，须罗娑就把嘴张到二十由旬；哈奴曼变到三十由旬，她就张到四十由旬……一直到哈奴曼变成九十由旬，她的嘴张到了一百由旬。这时，哈奴曼忽然把身体缩得像拇指那么小，飞快地钻进她的嘴里，又从她的嘴里飞了出来，笑着说：我已经进了你的嘴，你的恩典也实现了，现在我要去找悉多了。须罗娑恢复了原形，祝福他说：去吧，愿你成功！哈奴曼继续向前飞。海中还住着一个女妖，名叫辛悉迦，她能抓住飞过天空的生物在水中的影子，把它们拖下来吃掉。哈奴曼忽然觉得自己飞不动了，像逆风行驶的船一样，低头一看，一个巨大的女妖从海里抬起头来，张着地狱一样的大嘴等着他。哈奴曼想起须羯哩婆说过的这种能抓影子的怪物，就把身体变大，女妖也把嘴张大，哈奴曼又一下子缩小，钻进她的嘴里，用利爪撕开了她的心脏，从她的身体里冲了出来。辛悉迦沉入海底死了，空中的众神欢呼起来。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·须罗娑与辛悉迦。

sections.bodyEn: Hanumān landed fresh on three-peaked Trikūṭa and looked at Laṅkā: golden walls, jewelled gates, palaces touching the clouds, lotus-filled moats and armed rākṣasas on every wall, like a city of the gods. Not even the wind could slip in; how could Rāma's army take it? He must find Sītā first, and only after dark. He shrank to the size of a cat. When the moon rose he leapt onto the wall, and a terrible woman barred his way — Laṅkā, guardian goddess of the city — and struck him. He hit back lightly with his left fist, fearing to kill a woman, but she fell, and said that Brahmā had foretold that when a monkey overcame her, the rākṣasas' doom would begin. That day had come: let him enter and search for Sītā.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼终于看见了海那边的岛屿：岛上有一座三峰山，山顶上就是楞伽城。他落在三峰山上，一点也不觉得累。他望着楞伽城：金色的城墙，宝石装饰的城门，高耸入云的宫殿，护城河里开满了莲花，城墙上站满了手持武器的罗刹守卫，就像天上的城市一样。哈奴曼想：这座城守卫这样严密，连风都很难吹进去，罗摩的大军怎么能攻下它呢？我必须先找到悉多。白天进城会被发现，我等到天黑再说。他把身体缩得像一只猫那么大。夜幕降临，明月升起，哈奴曼跳上城墙，正要进城，一个可怕的女人拦住了他，她叫楞伽，是这座城的守护女神。她大喝一声：你是谁？竟敢闯进罗波那的城市！哈奴曼说：我想看看这座美丽的城市。女神大怒，一掌打在哈奴曼身上。哈奴曼也用左手握拳，轻轻地打了她一下——他怕打死女人，所以没有用力。可是女神还是被打倒在地，说：猴子，我从梵天那里听说过：将来有一天，一只猴子会打败我，那就是罗刹们毁灭的开始。现在这一天到了。你进城去吧，去做你想做的事，去找悉多吧。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·楞伽城的守护女神。

sections.bodyEn: Moonlight lit the streets as Hanumān searched: houses ringing with song, Vedic recitation, drinking and quarrels; guards with one eye or one ear, pot-bellies or humps. He searched the palaces of Kumbhakarṇa, Vibhīṣaṇa and Indrajit, then Rāvaṇa's, where stood the flying chariot Puṣpaka, seized from Kubera. In Rāvaṇa's chamber hundreds of women — nymphs, gandharva and nāga women, princesses carried off from everywhere — slept among instruments and scattered jewels, and Rāvaṇa snored on a crystal bed like a cloud-covered mountain. On another couch lay a woman of matchless beauty, and Hanumān leapt and kissed his own tail for joy — but then thought: Sītā, parted from Rāma, would never sleep so soundly, adorned and drunk, beside another man. It was the queen Mandodarī. Despairing, he almost resolved to fast to death, then remembered the aśoka grove.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼在楞伽城中穿行，月光照亮了街道。他看见罗刹们的宅院里传出歌声和笑声，有的在念吠陀，有的在饮酒，有的在争吵；他看见手持各种兵器的卫兵，有的长着一只眼睛，有的长着一只耳朵，有的长着大肚子，有的长着驼背。他一座宫殿一座宫殿地寻找：鸠槃羯叻拿的宫殿、维毗沙那的宫殿、因陀罗耆的宫殿……都没有悉多。最后他来到罗波那的王宫，宫中有一辆名叫“布湿波迦”的飞车，是从财神俱比罗那里抢来的，车身由宝石和金子打造，能随心所欲地飞到任何地方。他走进罗波那的寝宫，看见满屋子睡着成百上千的美女，她们是罗波那从各地抢来的天女、乾闼婆女、龙女和王族女子，有的抱着乐器睡着了，有的醉倒在地上，首饰散落一地。罗波那躺在一张水晶床上，像一座乌云覆盖的大山，打着鼾。旁边的一张床上睡着一位美丽无比的女子，哈奴曼一看，心想：这一定是悉多！他高兴得拍手跳跃，亲吻自己的尾巴。可是他转念一想：不对。悉多离开了罗摩，怎么会睡得这样安稳？怎么会戴着首饰、喝醉了酒？她绝不会和别的男人睡在一起。这个女人一定不是悉多。原来她是罗波那的王后曼度陀哩。哈奴曼找遍了整个王宫，还是没有找到悉多，心中十分沮丧，想到须羯哩婆的期限，想到罗摩的悲伤，他甚至想就在这里绝食而死。可是他又振作起来：我还没有找遍，还有那座无忧树林！
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·夜探罗波那的王宫。

sections.bodyEn: Hanumān leapt the wall into the flowering aśoka grove and climbed a leafy śiṃśapā tree. Near a white domed shrine sat a woman in a dusty yellow garment, thin and pale, her hair in a single long braid, without ornaments — like a new moon veiled by cloud or a flame wrapped in smoke — sighing, weeping and murmuring Rāma's name. Around her sat hideous rākṣasīs, one-eyed, one-eared, ears big enough to wrap their bodies, heads of horses, asses and boars, holding spears and hammers. Remembering Rāma's description and matching the ornaments she still wore to those found on Sugrīva's mountain, Hanumān knew her for Sītā. For her Rāma had killed Vālin and Khara's thousands, and for her it would be worth turning the world over; rather than yield to Rāvaṇa she endured all. He wept with reverence.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼跳过围墙，进入无忧树林。林中开满了鲜花，树木高大，池塘清澈，鸟儿在枝头栖息。他爬上一棵枝叶茂密的辛沙巴树，四处张望。不远处有一座白色的圆顶神庙，庙前坐着一个女子。她穿着一件沾满尘土的黄色衣服，身体消瘦，脸色苍白，一条长长的发辫拖在背后，没有戴任何首饰，像被乌云遮住的新月，像被烟雾包围的火焰。她不停地叹气，眼泪顺着脸颊流下来，嘴里念着罗摩的名字。她的周围坐着许多面目狰狞的女罗刹：有的只有一只眼睛，有的只有一只耳朵，有的耳朵大得能把身体包起来，有的长着马头、驴头、猪头，手里拿着长矛和铁锤。哈奴曼仔细看着这个女子，想起罗摩描述过的模样，又认出她身上戴着的几件首饰，正和须羯哩婆山上发现的那些首饰配成一套。他心想：这一定是悉多！罗摩为了她，杀死了波林，杀死了伽罗和一万四千罗刹，为了她，就算罗摩把整个世界翻过来，也是值得的。她宁愿受苦，也不肯屈服于罗波那。他不禁流下了眼泪，心中充满了敬意。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·无忧树林中的悉多。

sections.bodyEn: Near dawn Rāvaṇa came with a hundred wives bearing golden lamps, half drunk and burning with desire. Sītā curled up, arms across her breast, and wept. Why hide, he asked — the loveliest woman in three worlds, wasting her youth in dirty clothes: let her be his chief queen over all his treasure and wives; Rāma was a banished ascetic who would never find her or defeat him. Sītā picked up a blade of grass, set it between them and answered across it: let him love his own wives; she belonged to Rāma as light to the sun; if he wanted to live, he should return her and beg Rāma's pardon, or Rāma's arrows would fall like thunderbolts on Laṅkā. Furious, he told her two months of her term remained — then his cooks would mince her for breakfast — and ordered the rākṣasīs to break her by threats or coaxing.
sections.bodyZh: 天快亮的时候，罗波那带着上百个妻子来到无忧树林，宫女们举着金灯，簇拥着他，他喝得半醉，欲火中烧，径直走到悉多面前。悉多看见他，蜷缩起身体，用双臂遮住胸口，低着头哭泣。罗波那对她说：悉多，你为什么要躲着我？你是三界中最美的女人，却穿着脏衣服、不戴首饰，白白浪费你的青春。做我的王后吧，我的一切财宝、我的王国、我所有的妻子，都归你管。罗摩不过是一个被赶出王宫的苦行者，他永远也找不到你，就算找到了，也打不过我。悉多从地上拾起一根草，放在她和罗波那之间，隔着那根草对他说：罗波那，你把心思从我身上收回去吧，去爱你自己的妻子。我是罗摩的妻子，就像太阳的光芒属于太阳一样，我只属于罗摩。如果你想活命，就把我还给罗摩，向他求饶，他会宽恕你的。否则，罗摩的箭会像雷霆一样落在楞伽城上，你和你的罗刹们都会毁灭。罗波那大怒，说：我给你的期限还剩两个月。两个月以后你还不肯上我的床，我的厨师就会把你剁碎了做我的早饭！他吩咐女罗刹们：用尽一切办法，威胁也好，劝说也好，让她屈服！说完，他怒气冲冲地走了。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·罗波那的求爱与悉多的回答。

sections.bodyEn: The rākṣasīs crowded round Sītā, some coaxing her toward the riches of Rāvaṇa's queen, others brandishing spears and axes and lolling their tongues, one wanting her heart, one her liver, one her blood. Trembling against the śiṃśapā tree, Sītā cried for Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and Kausalyā and vowed to die rather than let Rāvaṇa touch her. Then the old rākṣasī Trijaṭā woke and told the others to eat each other and leave Sītā alone: she had dreamed of Rāma in white with Lakṣmaṇa in an ivory chariot drawn by a thousand white horses, reunited with Sītā in white on a white mountain; and of Rāvaṇa shaven, smeared with oil, in red, drunk on a donkey going south into a mud pit, Kumbhakarṇa and Indrajit after him, and Laṅkā burned by a monkey and sunk in the sea. Better beg Sītā's protection. The rākṣasīs fell silent in fear.
sections.bodyZh: 罗波那走后，女罗刹们围住悉多，有的劝她：罗波那是天下最强大的国王，你做他的王后，有享不尽的荣华富贵，何必为了一个穷苦行者受苦？有的威胁她：你要是再不答应，我们就把你撕碎吃掉！她们挥舞着长矛和斧头，伸出长长的舌头，一个说要吃她的心，一个说要吃她的肝，一个说要喝她的血。悉多吓得浑身发抖，靠着那棵辛沙巴树哭泣：罗摩，你在哪里？罗什曼那，你在哪里？母亲憍萨厘雅，你在哪里？我宁愿死，也不会让罗波那碰我一下。这时，一个年老的女罗刹特哩阇吒刚刚醒来，对其他女罗刹说：你们自己吃自己吧，不要碰悉多！我刚才做了一个可怕的梦：我梦见罗摩穿着白衣，戴着白色的花环，和罗什曼那一起坐在一辆由一千匹白马拉着的象牙车上，从天而降；悉多穿着白衣，坐在一座白色的山顶上，和罗摩团聚了。我又梦见罗波那剃光了头，浑身涂满了油，穿着红衣，喝醉了酒，骑着一头驴往南方去，掉进了一个泥坑里；鸠槃羯叻拿和因陀罗耆也剃光了头，往南方去了；楞伽城被一只猴子烧成了灰烬，沉入了大海。这个梦预示着罗摩会胜利，罗刹们会毁灭。我们还是向悉多求饶吧，她会保护我们的。女罗刹们听了，都害怕起来，不敢再威胁悉多了。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·特哩阇吒的梦。

sections.bodyEn: Alone and despairing, Sītā loosened her long braid to hang herself from a branch — and then her left eye, arm and thigh began to throb, an auspicious sign for a woman, and her heart steadied. Hanumān reasoned that if he appeared suddenly she would take him for Rāvaṇa in disguise and cry out; if he spoke Sanskrit like a brahmin she would suspect Rāvaṇa; better to speak in ordinary language and tell of Rāma first. From the tree he softly sang: King Daśaratha's son Rāma went to the forest to keep his father's word, killed Khara's fourteen thousand, lost Sītā to Rāvaṇa's golden deer, allied with Sugrīva and killed Vālin; Sugrīva's monkeys searched everywhere, and one had crossed a hundred leagues of sea and found her here. Looking up, Sītā saw a small monkey among the branches, and wondered whether she was dreaming or Rāvaṇa was tricking her again.
sections.bodyZh: 悉多孤零零地坐在树下，绝望之中，她解下自己的长发辫，想用它吊死在树枝上。这时，她的左眼、左臂和左腿开始跳动——这是女人的吉兆，她的心稍稍平静了一些。哈奴曼在树上看着这一切，心想：我要是突然出现在她面前，她一定会以为我是罗波那变的，吓得大叫，惊动女罗刹们。我要是用梵语说话，她会以为我是罗波那；我还是用普通人的语言，先说说罗摩的事，让她安心。他就在树上，用柔和的声音轻轻唱了起来：从前有一位国王，名叫十车王，他有一个儿子名叫罗摩，是世上最优秀的人。为了遵守父亲的诺言，罗摩带着妻子悉多和弟弟罗什曼那到森林里流放。在森林里，罗摩杀死了伽罗和一万四千罗刹。罗波那用金鹿引开了罗摩，劫走了悉多。罗摩悲伤地寻找妻子，和猴王须羯哩婆结为朋友，杀死了波林。须羯哩婆派出成千上万的猴子寻找悉多，我是其中之一，我跨过了一百由旬的大海，终于在这里找到了她……悉多听见这歌声，抬头望去，看见树枝间坐着一只穿着白衣、面色像无忧花一样的小猴子，她吓了一跳，心想：我是不是在做梦？是不是罗波那又在用幻术骗我？
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·哈奴曼的歌。
sections.headingEn: Rāma's story sung from the tree

sections.bodyEn: Hanumān climbed down and bowed: was she Sītā? She was — given two months by Rāvaṇa. He was Rāma's messenger, Hanumān son of the wind; Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa were well and thought of her day and night. When she doubted, he described Rāma's lotus eyes, broad shoulders, arms reaching to his knees and drum-like voice, and told of the alliance; then he gave her Rāma's ring engraved with his name, and she pressed it to her heart as if it were her husband, weeping with joy and sorrow. He offered to carry her home and grew mountain-high to prove he could. She trusted his strength but refused: the rākṣasas would pursue him and she might fall into the sea; she would not willingly touch any man but Rāma — Rāvaṇa had seized her by force; and Rāma himself must defeat Rāvaṇa and take her back, as befitted his honour. She gave Hanumān the jewel from her hair: let Rāma come within a month, for she could not live longer.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼从树上下来，恭恭敬敬地向悉多行礼，说：您是谁？您是悉多吗？悉多说：我是遮那竭的女儿，罗摩的妻子悉多。罗波那把我劫到这里，给了我两个月的期限。哈奴曼说：我是罗摩的使者，风神之子哈奴曼。罗摩和罗什曼那都很平安，他们日夜思念您。悉多起初还有些怀疑，哈奴曼就详细描述了罗摩的相貌：他的眼睛像莲花，肩膀宽阔，手臂长过膝盖，声音像鼓声……又讲了罗摩和须羯哩婆结盟的经过。然后他拿出罗摩的戒指，说：这是罗摩交给我的，上面刻着他的名字。悉多接过戒指，像见到了丈夫一样，紧紧贴在胸口，又悲又喜，泪流满面。哈奴曼说：您现在就坐到我的背上来，我带您跨过大海，回到罗摩身边。悉多说：哈奴曼，你的身体这样小，怎么能背我过海？哈奴曼就把身体变得像一座山一样高大。悉多说：我相信你的力量。可是我不能跟你走。罗刹们会追赶你，我会从你背上掉进海里。而且，我不愿意主动碰触罗摩以外的男人的身体——罗波那劫我时抓住我，是我无法反抗。更重要的是，应该由罗摩亲自来打败罗波那、救我回去，这样才能洗雪他的耻辱，配得上他的英名。她从头发里取下一颗宝珠，交给哈奴曼说：这是我的髻珠，罗摩看见它，就会想起我，想起我的母亲和他的父亲。请你告诉他，我只能再活一个月，一个月以后他还不来，我就活不下去了。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·戒指与髻珠。

sections.bodyEn: So that Rāma would be sure, Sītā told a story only the two of them knew. On Citrakūṭa, as Rāma slept with his head in her lap, a crow pecked again and again at her breast until it bled, and she did not move for fear of waking him. Waking, Rāma saw the blood and the crow with bloody claws, plucked a blade of kuśa grass from his mat and charged it with the weapon of Brahmā. The crow — a son of Indra in disguise — fled through the three worlds, but no god or sage would shelter it from the blade, and at last it fell at Rāma's feet; since the weapon could not be wasted, it gave up its right eye and flew away. 'He loosed Brahmā's weapon for a crow that hurt me,' Sītā wept; 'why does he not come now?' Hanumān assured her that Rāma could neither eat nor sleep for longing and only did not know where she was; once told, he would come with millions of monkeys and bears.
sections.bodyZh: 为了让罗摩确信哈奴曼真的见到了她，悉多又讲了一件只有她和罗摩两个人知道的往事：那时我们住在质多罗俱吒山上，有一天，罗摩累了，枕在我的腿上睡着了。一只乌鸦飞来，用它的利爪和尖嘴一次又一次地啄我的胸口，我疼得流了血，却怕吵醒罗摩，一动也不敢动。罗摩醒来，看见我胸口流血，大怒，问是谁伤了我。他看见那只乌鸦，爪子上还沾着血，就从坐着的草垫上拔出一根吉祥草，念着咒语，把它变成梵天的神兵，向乌鸦射去。那只乌鸦原来是因陀罗的儿子变的，它飞遍了三界，向天神、仙人求救，可是谁也不敢收留它，那根草一直追着它不放。最后它只好飞回来，跪在罗摩脚下求饶。罗摩说：梵天的神兵一旦射出，就不能落空。乌鸦说：那就让它射掉我的右眼吧。那根草射瞎了乌鸦的右眼，乌鸦向罗摩和十车王致敬后飞走了。悉多哭着说：哈奴曼，罗摩为了一只伤害我的乌鸦，都动用了梵天的神兵，现在罗波那把我劫走，他为什么还不来救我？请你转告他，请他快来，用他的神兵消灭这些罗刹。哈奴曼安慰她说：罗摩日夜思念您，吃不下饭，睡不着觉，他只是还不知道您在哪里。我一回去告诉他，他就会率领千千万万的猴子和熊，跨过大海来救您。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·乌鸦的故事。

sections.bodyEn: Having found Sītā, Hanumān resolved to test the rākṣasas' strength for Rāma. Like a storm he uprooted the grove, smashed pools and pavilions, sparing only Sītā's śiṃśapā tree. Rāvaṇa sent eighty thousand guards, whom Hanumān killed with an iron bar; then seven sons of his ministers, then five generals — none returned. Then young Prince Akṣa came in an eight-horse chariot; Hanumān admired his courage but, knowing he could not spare him, seized him by the legs, whirled him and dashed him to the ground. At last Rāvaṇa sent Indrajit, conqueror of Indra; when their duel in the sky was undecided, Indrajit bound Hanumān with the weapon of Brahmā. Knowing it would hold him only a moment, Hanumān let himself be tied with ropes and bark — which itself undid the weapon's bond — and was dragged before Rāvaṇa, glad of the chance to see him.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼告别了悉多，心想：我已经找到了悉多，可是还应该看看罗刹们的力量，好回去告诉罗摩。他像一阵狂风一样，在无忧树林里横冲直撞，拔起树木，砸碎池塘，推倒亭台，只留下悉多坐的那棵辛沙巴树。女罗刹们吓得跑去报告罗波那。罗波那派了八万名卫兵去捉他，哈奴曼拿起一根铁门闩，把他们全部打死；又派大臣的七个儿子带兵去，也都被他打死；又派五位大将去，同样有去无回。罗波那大怒，派他的小儿子阿刹王子去。阿刹驾着八匹马拉的战车，向哈奴曼射出箭雨，哈奴曼佩服这个年轻人的勇敢，可是他知道不能手下留情，就抓住阿刹的双腿，在空中抡了几圈，把他摔死在地上。罗波那又惊又怒，派出他最厉害的儿子因陀罗耆。因陀罗耆曾经打败过天帝因陀罗，所以才有这个名字。两人在空中激战，谁也伤不了谁。因陀罗耆便祭出梵天的神兵，把哈奴曼紧紧捆住。哈奴曼知道这件神兵只能捆住他片刻，可是他心想：我正好借这个机会去见见罗波那。于是他假装无力挣扎，让罗刹们用绳子和树皮把他捆起来——一捆上普通的绳子，梵天神兵的束缚就自动解除了，可是哈奴曼还是装作被捆住，任由他们推推搡搡地把他押到罗波那的宫殿上去。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·毁林与被擒。
sections.headingEn: The grove destroyed and Hanumān bound

sections.bodyEn: On his crystal throne under a pearl-studded crown, his eyes blazing in ten heads, Rāvaṇa was so splendid that Hanumān thought that, but for his evil, he might have been a protector of the gods. Asked whether Indra, Kubera or Vishnu had sent him, Hanumān said he was the envoy of Sugrīva and the servant of Rāma, come to find Sītā; he had wrecked the grove to be brought here and killed only those who tried to kill him. Sugrīva greeted Rāvaṇa: a king who knew dharma and had practised austerities should not steal another's wife. His boon protected him from gods and rākṣasas, but Rāma was a man and Sugrīva a monkey; let him return Sītā. Rāvaṇa ordered the monkey killed, but his brother Vibhīṣaṇa objected that envoys must never be slain — he might be beaten, shaved or branded, but not killed. So Rāvaṇa decreed: monkeys love their tails; burn his and send him home.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼被押到罗波那的大殿上。罗波那坐在水晶宝座上，戴着镶满珍珠的王冠，十个头上的眼睛像火一样燃烧，四个大臣站在他身边。哈奴曼看着他，心想：这个罗刹王真是威风凛凛，光芒四射。如果他不是这样作恶多端，他甚至可以做众神的保护者。罗波那命大臣问哈奴曼：你是谁？是谁派你来的？是因陀罗、俱比罗还是毗湿奴？为什么毁掉我的树林，杀死我的罗刹？哈奴曼说：我不是任何天神派来的，我是猴王须羯哩婆的使者，罗摩的仆人，风神之子哈奴曼。我来这里是为了寻找罗摩的妻子悉多。我毁掉树林，是为了见到你；我杀死罗刹，是因为他们要杀我。罗波那，须羯哩婆向你问好，他让我转告你：你是一个懂得正法的人，修行过苦行，不应该劫持别人的妻子。快把悉多还给罗摩吧！你从梵天那里得到的恩典，只能保护你不被天神和罗刹杀死，可罗摩是人，须羯哩婆是猴子，你的恩典保护不了你。就算全世界的天神和阿修罗一起来，也挡不住罗摩的箭。罗波那听了大怒，下令：杀了这只猴子！他的弟弟维毗沙那连忙劝阻：大王，自古以来，使者不能杀。不论他说了什么，杀死使者都违背正法，会让国王蒙受耻辱。您可以用别的方法惩罚他：可以把他打伤，可以剃掉他的毛，可以给他打上烙印，但不能杀他。罗波那想了想说：猴子最爱自己的尾巴，那就烧掉他的尾巴，让他带着烧焦的尾巴回去吧！
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·哈奴曼在罗波那殿前。

sections.bodyEn: The rākṣasas wrapped his tail in old cotton and rags, soaked it in oil, set it alight and paraded him through the streets with drums — which suited Hanumān, who studied the city's defences by day. When the rākṣasīs told Sītā, she lit a fire and prayed: if she had been faithful, if she had practised austerity, if Rāma loved her, let the fire be cool to Hanumān. Though his tail blazed, it felt cool as snow, and the wind fanned him. Shrinking, he slipped his bonds, grew mountain-high, killed his guards with an iron bar and leapt from roof to roof setting Laṅkā on fire; golden palaces melted, jewels burst, rākṣasas fled screaming — only Vibhīṣaṇa's house was spared. Quenching his tail in the sea, he was suddenly stricken: had he burned Sītā too? Voices of sky-dwelling sages said she was unharmed, but he ran back to see her safe beneath her tree before he was at peace.
sections.bodyZh: 罗刹们用旧棉布和破布把哈奴曼的尾巴一圈一圈地缠起来，浇上油，点着了火。他们敲着锣鼓，牵着他在楞伽城的大街上游行示众，大声宣布他的罪行。哈奴曼一声不吭，任由他们拉着，心想：这样正好，我可以在白天好好看看楞伽城的街道和防御。女罗刹们跑到无忧树林，告诉悉多：那只和你说话的红脸猴子，尾巴被点着了火，正在街上游行！悉多听了，心如刀割，她点燃祭火，向火神祈祷：如果我侍奉丈夫忠贞不渝，如果我修行过苦行，如果罗摩真心爱我，火神啊，请你对哈奴曼变得清凉吧！火神听见了她的祈祷，尾巴上的火虽然熊熊燃烧，哈奴曼却觉得像雪一样清凉，风神也在火焰旁吹着凉风。哈奴曼想：这一定是罗摩的威力、悉多的贞洁和我父亲的帮助。他忽然把身体缩小，挣脱了绳子，又变大成山一样，从地上捡起一根铁门闩，打死了押解的罗刹，跳上城门，然后带着燃烧的尾巴，从一座宫殿的屋顶跳到另一座宫殿的屋顶，把火点遍了整个楞伽城。火借风势，越烧越旺，金子做的宫殿熔化成金水流下来，宝石崩裂，罗刹们哭喊着四处逃命，整座城市像世界末日一样陷入火海——只有维毗沙那的宫殿没有被烧着。哈奴曼跳到海里，熄灭了尾巴上的火。他望着燃烧的楞伽城，忽然惊恐地想：糟了！我把整座城都烧了，悉多会不会也被烧死了？我真是愚蠢的猴子！正在懊悔，空中传来天上仙人们的声音：哈奴曼真了不起，他烧毁了楞伽城，可是悉多一点也没有受伤！哈奴曼还是不放心，又跑回无忧树林，看见悉多安然无恙地坐在那棵树下，这才放了心。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·火烧楞伽。

sections.bodyEn: Hanumān pressed Mount Ariṣṭa into the earth as he leapt and flew back like a cloud. On the northern shore the monkeys heard his victorious roar, and his first words were: 'I have seen Sītā!' They hugged him, grasped his hands and waved branches as he told his tale. Aṅgada wanted to storm Laṅkā at once, but Jāmbavān said their task was to find Sītā, not to rob Rāma of his vow to rescue her himself. On the way back they burst into Sugrīva's beloved honey grove, drank it dry and beat its old keeper Dadhimukha — and when he complained, Sugrīva rejoiced: they would only dare this if they had found Sītā. Before Rāma, Hanumān knelt and gave him the crest-jewel and Sītā's words and the story of the crow. Rāma pressed the jewel to his breast in tears: it was like seeing Sītā, his father and Janaka. Hanumān had done what no one else could; all he could give him was an embrace — and he embraced him.
sections.bodyZh: 哈奴曼向悉多告别，登上楞伽城外的阿利湿多山，用力一蹬，大山都陷进了地里，他像一片乌云一样飞越大海。北岸上，猴子们正焦急地等着，听见空中传来哈奴曼胜利的吼声，都欢呼起来：哈奴曼回来了！他一定找到悉多了！哈奴曼落在摩亨陀罗山上，第一句话就是：我见到悉多了！猴子们围着他又跳又叫，有的拥抱他，有的拉他的手，有的折下树枝挥舞。哈奴曼把一路上的经过讲了一遍：跨海、找到悉多、罗波那的威胁、毁林、被擒、火烧楞伽……安伽陀说：我们干脆直接打进楞伽，杀了罗波那，把悉多救回来交给罗摩吧！老熊王阇婆梵说：我们的任务是找到悉多，不是救她。罗摩发誓要亲自救回妻子，我们不能抢了他的荣誉。猴子们兴高采烈地往回走，路过须羯哩婆心爱的蜜林时，他们忍不住冲进去，喝光了树上的蜂蜜，把看守蜜林的老猴子达底牟迦打了一顿。达底牟迦跑去向须羯哩婆告状，须羯哩婆却高兴地说：他们敢这样做，一定是找到悉多了！猴子们来到罗摩面前，哈奴曼跪下说：我见到悉多了，她平安无事，一心想着你。他把髻珠交给罗摩，又转达了悉多的话和乌鸦的故事。罗摩把髻珠贴在胸前，泪流满面，说：我看见这颗珠子，就像看见了悉多，看见了我的父亲和遮那竭王。哈奴曼，你做了一件谁也做不到的事，我拿什么来报答你呢？我只能拥抱你。说着，他紧紧地拥抱了哈奴曼。
sections.evidenceNote: 格里菲斯译本第五卷·归来与蜜林。
